text: A team will automate an approved configuration change across 40 switches. Which practice best reduces accidental changes to the wrong devices?
correct: Validate the target inventory and intended diff before applying the bounded change
distractors: Run against every discovered IP address without checking ownership
Assume repeatable tooling makes scope review unnecessary
Suppress failed-device reporting so the batch appears successful
explanation: Automation can repeat a mistake at scale as easily as a correct change. Verifying inventory, intended differences and scope before execution helps preserve the approved boundary; post-change checks and failure reporting remain necessary. Repeatability is not a substitute for approval or validation.

text: An orchestration application asks a network controller for topology and policy information. Which controller interface direction describes this application-to-controller interaction?
distractors: Southbound device-control interface
A host's default-gateway ARP cache
An access-port VLAN assignment
explanation: Northbound APIs expose controller services to applications or orchestration systems. Southbound interfaces connect the controller's control functions with managed infrastructure. These directions describe architectural relationships, not compass locations or Ethernet port modes.

text: A tunnel-based overlay provides logical network segments above an IP-routed fabric. What is the underlay's main role in this design?
correct: Provide transport reachability between tunnel endpoints
distractors: Replace every overlay segment with a DNS record
Require the controller to forward every data packet itself
Store user passwords as the only forwarding information
explanation: The underlay supplies the connectivity that carries encapsulated traffic between overlay endpoints. The overlay can present logical segmentation independently of the physical topology. A controller may coordinate policy without being in every packet's data path.

text: An authenticated REST client needs to retrieve an existing interface resource without requesting a configuration change. Which HTTP method normally expresses this read operation?
distractors: DELETE
POST used to create a new interface resource
PATCH used to modify interface attributes
explanation: GET normally retrieves a representation of an existing resource and is defined as a safe read method. POST, PATCH and DELETE have different intended semantics. Authentication and endpoint permissions are still required even for a read.

text: An API response is {"enabled":true,"vlans":[10,20]}. Which interpretation preserves its JSON types and values?
correct: enabled is a boolean true and the second vlans array element is the number 20
distractors: enabled is the string true and vlans is a single string
enabled is a numeric interface index and vlans contains only one element
The response is invalid because JSON cannot contain arrays
explanation: Unquoted true is a JSON boolean. Brackets enclose an array, and [10,20] contains two numeric elements, with 20 second. Quoted strings, booleans and numbers are distinct data types; converting them indiscriminately can change an API request's meaning.

text: A protected REST endpoint rejects a request with HTTP 401 because its bearer credential is missing or invalid. What should the client address first?
distractors: Deleting the resource to avoid authentication
Changing the response format from JSON to YAML to gain permission
Treating 401 as proof that an authenticated user has the required role
explanation: 401 identifies an authentication requirement or invalid credentials in this stated scenario. A validly authenticated account can still lack authorization; that is a separate issue, commonly expressed by 403. Changing serialization or deleting resources is not a credential fix.

text: A team selects an Ansible network module and supported transport to manage switches without installing a persistent automation agent on each switch. Which characteristic does this illustrate?
correct: Agentless management using supported remote interfaces
distractors: A requirement to install the same Ansible daemon on every network device
A guarantee that authentication is unnecessary
A rule that playbooks cannot contain multiple tasks
explanation: Ansible commonly manages network devices through supported remote transports rather than a resident Ansible agent. Transport/module compatibility and authorized credentials still matter. Agentless operation does not eliminate authentication, and playbooks can contain multiple tasks.

text: A Terraform configuration describes desired cloud-network resources. Which step lets a reviewer inspect proposed changes before approving their application?
correct: Generate and review a Terraform plan
distractors: Delete the state file before each run to hide existing resources
Apply every change immediately without reviewing the resource scope
Replace the desired configuration with random addresses
explanation: A plan compares the configuration and known resource state to show intended changes before apply. Reviewing scope and consequences supports a controlled workflow. Deleting state can impair resource tracking and is not a safe review method.

text: A system learns patterns in historical link-utilization measurements and estimates next week's congestion risk. Which AI use best describes that activity?
distractors: Generating a new router configuration solely from a text prompt
Encrypting packets by replacing their headers with AI output
Replacing all measurements with an administrator's password
explanation: Forecasting future behavior from historical telemetry is predictive analysis and may use machine-learning models. Generating new text or commands is a generative task. Prediction quality must be tested against real outcomes and changing traffic conditions; the forecast is not guaranteed fact.

text: A generative AI assistant proposes a router configuration that looks plausible but includes a command unsupported by the target platform. What is the appropriate next action before any production application?
correct: Review the proposal against the target platform's documentation and validate it in an approved test context
distractors: Apply it immediately because confident language guarantees correctness
Disable validation so unsupported commands cannot block deployment
Share production credentials publicly to improve the model's confidence
explanation: Generated configuration text can be inaccurate or unsupported even when fluent. Check platform/version compatibility, intended behavior and scope, then validate through an approved process before deployment. Confidence of presentation is not technical evidence or authorization.
